meta.note: tier-2 mix per day: 3 quote-react, 2 original-showcase (video), 2 original-text, 1 retweet, plus a repliesTarget of >=10 substantive replies. no hashtags anywhere. no links in main-post copy — links live only in the selfReply of showcase posts. every 7th day (day 7, day 14) carries a personal-vulnerability or craft-advice slot, tagged via "subtype" on an original-text slot. all original-showcase/original-text copy scored with features/x-growth scoreXPost; scores stored per-slot.
